links.effect: RNFL thinning detection was better in moderate-to-advanced glaucoma, especially temporal sectors, while nasal performance was better for mild cases; not stratified by site or device.
links.quote: Stratified analysis revealed better RNFL thinning detection in moderate-to-advanced glaucoma cases, especially in temporal sectors, while performance in nasal regions was better for mild cases.

unlisted_practices: Image-quality triage with fixed refusal statement for unusable OCT scans
Structured report generation from fine-tuned multimodal LLM

screen.reason: The study develops and benchmarks an explainable multimodal LLM for OCT scan quality triage and automated structured report generation on a held-out retrospective dataset.
